versions.changelog:
Initial release of 美妆带货短视频脚本生成器 (Beauty Product Short-Video Script Generator):

- Generates short-video scripts for beauty products, tailored for creators and e-commerce sellers.
- Supports talking-head, drama, and product-seeding (种草) formats with customized script structures.
- Outputs include: attention-grabbing title, fixed duration (30s/60s), detailed four-column storyboard (time/visuals/voiceover/notes), and colloquial voiceover lines (max 15 characters each).
- Ensures a strong hook in the first 3 seconds and a clear cart/call-to-action at the end.
- Automatically extracts product, type, and duration; defaults provided if not specified by user.
- Designed for immediate use without back-and-forth prompting.
